articles.title: Pharmacists Urged to Engage Employers Directly as PBM Industry Evolves
articles.summary: As pharmacy benefit managers rethink traditional business models under intense market and regulatory pressure, industry experts advise community pharmacists to forge direct communications with self-funded employers. This shift highlights how employer health plan sponsors are increasingly looking beyond conventional PBM structures to manage pharmacy costs and optimize benefits. For self-funded plans, engaging with local pharmacist networks presents emerging opportunities to explore alternative, transparent clinical care and cost-containment strategies.
articles.source_line: Source: Drug Topics; Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:46:35 GMT

articles.title: DOL Finalizes PBM Fee Disclosure Rules for Self-Insured Health Plans
articles.summary: The Department of Labor has finalized new fee disclosure rules specifically targeting pharmacy benefit managers for self-insured group health plans. This regulation increases transparency around PBM compensation, requiring plan fiduciaries to carefully evaluate direct and indirect service fees. The rule gives self-funded employers greater visibility into hidden costs to help improve plan design and fiduciary compliance.
articles.source_line: Source: JD Supra; Wed, 25 Nov 2026 21:13:58 GMT

articles.title: Drug Importation Crackdown Impacts Employer Plans and PBM Strategies
articles.summary: Federal crackdowns on international drug importation are forcing self-funded employers and pharmacy benefit managers to reassess their sourcing strategies for managing high prescription drug costs. As regulatory scrutiny increases, plan sponsors must navigate tighter supply chains and evaluate alternative cost-containment measures for domestic spend. This shift directly impacts how PBMs structure formularies and manage specialty drug expenses for employer groups.
articles.source_line: Source: Modern Healthcare; Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:35:10 GMT

articles.title: The Ongoing Affordability Crisis of GLP-1 Medications for Self-Funded Plans
articles.summary: High-cost GLP-1 medications continue to strain self-funded employer health plan budgets despite their proven clinical effectiveness. Employers are increasingly forced to reevaluate plan designs, utilization management, and coverage strategies to manage escalating specialty drug spend. This dynamic directly impacts how PBMs structure weight-loss drug management for commercial group health plans.

articles.title: Employers Urged to Speak Up on Healthcare Affordability Following Midterms
articles.summary: Following the midterms where healthcare affordability emerged as a central voter concern, employers are being urged to advocate for policy changes and cost containment. As purchasers of self-funded health plans, employers face mounting pressure to address rising medical and pharmacy benefit costs. The call to action highlights the growing necessity for employer-led influence in legislative and market healthcare reform.

articles.title: Legal Scrutiny Grows Over PBM Prior Authorization Practices and Audits
articles.summary: A legal review highlights increasing regulatory and legal scrutiny surrounding pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) prior authorization audits and operational practices. This trend impacts how PBMs manage utilization management tools, creating potential compliance and liability concerns for self-funded health plans.
articles.source_line: Source: Drug Topics; Wed, 25 Nov 2026 19:42:50 GMT
